source: Met-Pro Dean RA data pak, performance curves on PDF pages 10-22. Re-read from the hi-res sheets on the printed grid. Page 22 head scale is 100-450 ft.
rules: Numbers are heads in feet at the listed flow in gpm, read from the printed diameter line.
A line ends where the printed stroke ends. Heads are not invented past that end, and a flat tail is not added.
Head falls or stays level as flow rises. A trim uses D^2 interpolation at constant flow between the two bracketing printed lines, and only where both lines exist.
Efficiency, BHP and NPSHr are read for each size. NPSHr is the curve at that speed and is not scaled from another speed.
These curves apply only at 70 SSU or less.
The catalog has no curve for a pump larger than 10 in.

npshr_contours.note: NPSHr where the dashed contours cross the 10 in line
